connectsTo: The owner's Gmail account (OAuth), sending from the owner's address or a dedicated assistant address the owner chooses.
permissions: Gmail OAuth scopes: gmail.readonly, gmail.compose (includes sending); gmail.send alone is sending-only but cannot read replies
riskNote: Messages go out in the owner's name. The limits that matter (two touches at most, business hours, never a do-not-contact customer, an invoice over the limit becomes a draft) must be enforced by ledger.touch refusing the send, not by the model. Same server, version, telemetry setting and restricted-scope questions as email.drafts. Credentials are held on the host and never in a blueprint.
